caption: A California Prop 65 warning from the template, targeted at the US. Targeting specific US states, so California only, is locked behind Premium. The store name is hidden.

We saved a Textual Warning block in the theme, but the editor only shows the placeholder Textual warning will appear here. We never saw the warning in the shop. The store name and warning ID are hidden.
Free allows 1 warning. Premium Yearly costs $3.49 a month billed annually, which adds US state targeting and Prevent checkout. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Premium Yearly: $41.94 a year after a 7-day trial ending 24 Nov, and a payment method is required. We approved nothing. The store name is hidden.

The uninstall dialog says app data is deleted and a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete customer data. Uninstall stays greyed out until you pick a reason. The store name is hidden.
